prompt: Some people believe that it is best to accept a bad situation, such as an unsatisfactoryjob or shortage of money. Others argue that it is better to try and improve such situations. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion. Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
It is an undeniable statement that we learn the best from our mistakes. Nowadays, the general public is debating whether acceptance is the key to going through a bad condition or whether they should take action to improve it. In my opinion, realisation is important if a mishappening occurs , but we must take the initiative to bring out a better outcome from such a situation. It is necessary to get a lesson from our past inconveniences.

First and foremost, considering acceptance a better option is preferred sometimes, because of the severity of the circumstances. In some cases, there is nothing that could be done other than surrendering to the affairs. For example, if someone is not happy with the job that they are doing and they are constantly looking for a new job, but are unable to find one, they have to be very patient and accept the current job. In such cases a person must avoid taking actions such as facing their supervisors to ask for a better paygrade since that could raise a conflict which could result in them losing their job. So, to support their lifestyle and avoid facing a financial loss , they must show acceptance.

On the other hand, trying to take action and make a case better can work very well in a scenario where we have some control over it. For example, if a person is stuck in a similar situation as above but their financial situation is much better, they must take action to improve the situation and learn some skills to acquire a better earning job, they can go ahead and face the company to ask for a raise or simply just look for a new workplace. It is not always in our favour to surrender  because there are possibilities to change the result of some situations, as explained above.

In conclusion, I strongly believe that we should take a step under some circumstances to face a better outcome unless it is totally out of our control. It is clear that occasionally it is best to just stay put , but otherwise we must put our efforts into staying out of regrets.
